verdict.rationale: ClickUp's Public API covers a broad core surface: creating, updating and moving tasks, attachments, custom fields and task types, filtering, full CRUD on views, and comments. An OpenAPI spec is published per API version, and the MCP server adds search, time tracking and docs. However, nothing in the evidence claims UI parity, and many of the product's advertised UI surfaces have no evidenced API coverage. Missing for 10: API coverage of Whiteboards, Automations, Proofing, Sprints and Chat messaging; any explicit UI-parity statement; independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage breadth.
